subject.title: WhatsApp session stalls on long model_call: incomplete turn with payloads=0, reply never delivered

question: Should this issue stay open for a WhatsApp final-error delivery fix despite PR #102160's run-lifecycle improvements?
rationale: Current source still suppresses WhatsApp final `isError` payloads, while the latest comment argues the run/dispatch layer fixed both root causes; deciding whether that source-level gap is acceptable needs maintainer proof or direction.

options.title: Keep Open For Delivery Fix
options.body: Treat PR #102160 as a partial run-lifecycle fix and require a WhatsApp final-error delivery fix or live proof before closing.

options.title: Close After Live Proof
options.body: Close only if a maintainer provides release/current-main WhatsApp proof showing an incomplete-turn fallback reaches the user despite the adapter suppression.

options.title: Fold Into Durable Delivery Contract
options.body: Move the remaining final-error delivery work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 and close this only after that canonical path explicitly preserves this incident.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Delivery Fix
recommendation.body: Treat PR #102160 as a partial run-lifecycle fix and require a WhatsApp final-error delivery fix or live proof before closing.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is assigned to this issue and owns the broader durable final fallback delivery contract issue.
